toolprompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: horizontal character turnaround sheet for a game art reference
Input image 1 is the approved Iris coat-variant design and the only visual reference. Preserve Iris exactly: young adult woman, silver-white very long hair with half-up braid and large purple ribbon, light violet eyes, calm gentle expression, exact shared inner outfit of ivory ruffled blouse with purple neck ribbon, purple vest with gold buttons, brown belt, navy long skirt with pale-lavender hem band and ivory ruffle, brown boots with no front laces and two round gold buttons on each boot, plus the oversized brown coat draped over the shoulders with empty sleeves hanging; no book.
Create one wide horizontal sheet with exactly THREE full-body drawings of the same Iris coat variant, equally spaced left to right, identical scale, same head-top and foot-bottom baseline:
1) FRONT: strict 0-degree front-facing neutral standing view.
2) SIDE: strict 90-degree true side profile facing RIGHT; nose, chest and toes point right, back of head left. No three-quarter.
3) BACK: strict 180-degree rear view.
Neutral turnaround pose: the oversized coat remains draped over the shoulders with arms not inserted into the coat sleeves; empty coat sleeves hang visibly beside the body. Hands are naturally together in front and the inner outfit remains visible. Feet parallel, no dramatic action pose or exaggerated T-pose. Preserve braid, ribbon, coat length, skirt hem and boots through rotation. Back view should add only the restrained logical continuation of the brown coat and existing inner clothing, without invented decoration. No book in any of the three figures.
Full hair and feet visible, identical scale and baseline, generous spacing.
Background: flat white to warm ivory, no perspective, no dramatic light, no large ground shadows. Add only small English labels FRONT, SIDE, BACK below the figures. No other text, no character name, no watermark.
Avoid: any 3/4 angle, mirrored side direction, putting arms through coat sleeves, replacing the oversized coat with a fitted jacket or cape, adding a book, changing inner outfit, laced boots, extra figures, child/chibi proportions, cropped head or feet.
